newsitem.title: USA: Global Maintech develops mainframe tool.
newsitem.headline: Global Maintech develops mainframe tool.

text.p: Global Maintech Corp said Monday it developed a new software tool for monitoring and managing International Business Machines Corp "SNA/VTAM' networks.

The software is called the Global Watch - MVS (Multiple Virtual Storage)/SNA (System Network Architecture). SNA is the protocol used by IBM mainframes to talk to other devices. MVS is the main operating system for IBM mainframe computers.
VTAM, or Virtual Telecommunications Access Method, is the communications software on the mainframe.
Global Maintech estimates there are 25,000 IBM-style networks worldwide that can use this software.
